comparison.objective: Close a shipping carton's four flaps in preparation for taping.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequenced folding and interleaving of compliant carton flaps.
comparison.success_condition: All four flaps closed and carton ready for taping; body and pose/closure thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Compliant flap sequencing is unrelated to precision metal-tool alignment, contact-loaded fracture, and millimetre-scale debris recovery.
